explicitOptions.channelIndex: Required for more than one channel; zero-based 0..63
explicitOptions.sampleZero: Required for unsigned component encodings; no ADC midpoint inference
explicitOptions.realMode: i-only is required for real encodings; Q is explicitly zero, with no Hilbert/receiver recovery
explicitOptions.scale: Explicit positive sample-unit conversion, retaining existing saved-z-score inference

supportedMetadata: core:offset as absolute sample origin, separate from file-relative import sampleOffset
scoped captures: frequency, UTC datetime, global_index, geolocation
multiple increasing capture segments and non-conforming per-segment headers
declared matching non-conforming datasets with trailing byte counts
sorted annotations including capture-bounded implicit duration and paired frequency edges
bounded optional extension metadata retained without applying unknown calibration

export.container: ZIP convenience bundle, not a SigMF .sigmf tar archive
export.derivedMetadata: capture.sigmf-meta / new datatype, channel count, sample-index origin, UTC segments, clipped core annotations and conversion provenance
export.originalMetadata: source.sigmf-meta retained separately as source provenance; original ADC bytes are not retained/exported
export.units: Same managed float32 sample values; no resampling, normalization, or automatic calibration

unsupported: Unknown unsigned zero levels or unselected multichannel input
Arbitrary device formats not explicitly described as core datasets / named NCDs
compatibility: Legacy missing core:version/captures/annotations is accepted as prior application behavior; not advertised as full conformance validation.
